pages.text: $(bold)Congratulations!$() You've slain your first monster and proven yourself ready for combat.$(br2)This page unlocked because you completed the $(italic)First Blood$() quest. As you complete more quests, new Codex entries will appear.$(br2)$(bold)Combat Tips:$()$(br)$(li)Melee weapons have different speeds and reach$(br)$(li)Armor toughness reduces damage from heavy hits$(br)$(li)Shields block frontal damage — hold right-click$(br)$(li)Dodge by sprinting sideways — don't face-tank
